countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.hook: The Wakhan Corridor was drawn purely so Russia and British India would never touch.
countries.flagDescription: Currently a white field bearing the Shahada in black script.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked leaf with a long thin panhandle reaching toward China.

countries.name: Angola
countries.hook: Its oil-rich Cabinda province is cut off from the rest of the country by DR Congo.
countries.flagDescription: Red over black with a yellow machete, gear and star.
countries.outlineDescription: A large block on the Atlantic, plus the Cabinda exclave to the north.

countries.name: Albania
countries.hook: Albanians call it Shqipëri, "land of the eagles" — the flag is literally its name.
countries.flagDescription: Solid red field with a black double-headed eagle in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A small vertical wedge on the Adriatic, notched by the Bay of Vlorë.

countries.name: Andorra
countries.hook: The only country whose official language is Catalan, jointly ruled by a French president and a Spanish bishop.
countries.flagDescription: Blue-yellow-red vertical bands with the coat of arms centred.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny crumpled diamond wedged high in the Pyrenees.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.hook: A federation of seven emirates — Abu Dhabi has the oil, Dubai built the skyline.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and black bands with a vertical red stripe at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A small hook on the Persian Gulf, curling toward the Strait of Hormuz.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.hook: Stretches so far south that its tip is closer to Antarctica than to its own tropics.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue, white and light blue bands with the golden Sun of May.
countries.outlineDescription: A long tapering wedge running down to Tierra del Fuego.

countries.name: Armenia
countries.hook: The first country in the world to adopt Christianity as a state religion, in 301 AD.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: red, blue, orange.
countries.outlineDescription: A small landlocked shape cradled beneath the Caucasus.

countries.name: Antigua and Barbuda
countries.hook: Claims 365 beaches — one for every day of the year.
countries.flagDescription: A red field with a black, blue, white and gold rising-sun triangle.
countries.outlineDescription: Two small Caribbean islands with a deeply scalloped coast.

countries.name: Australia
countries.hook: The only country that is also a continent — and it is wider than the moon's diameter.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with the Union Jack, the Commonwealth Star and the Southern Cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A wide continental block with Tasmania dropped below its southeast corner.

countries.name: Austria
countries.hook: Vienna has been the world's most liveable city so often that the phrase is basically a tourism slogan.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: red, white, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A long frying pan whose handle points west into the Alps.

countries.name: Azerbaijan
countries.hook: "Land of fire" — natural gas seeps have burned on its hillsides for thousands of years.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, red and green bands with a white crescent and eight-pointed star.
countries.outlineDescription: A blob on the Caspian with a separate exclave, Nakhchivan, cut off to the west.

countries.name: Burundi
countries.hook: One of the most densely populated countries in Africa, and among the smallest.
countries.flagDescription: Red and green quarters split by a white saltire, with three stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny landlocked shape east of Lake Tanganyika.

countries.name: Belgium
countries.hook: Belgium once went 589 days without a government and barely noticed — the chocolate kept flowing.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: black, yellow, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A stubby triangle pinned between France, Germany and the North Sea.

countries.name: Benin
countries.hook: Vodun (voodoo) was born here and is still an official religion.
countries.flagDescription: Green hoist band with yellow over red horizontal bands.
countries.outlineDescription: A narrow vertical strip running north from a short coastline.

countries.name: Burkina Faso
countries.hook: Its name means "land of upright people" — renamed from Upper Volta in 1984.
countries.flagDescription: Red over green with a yellow star in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked oval in the Sahel bend of West Africa.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.hook: Almost the entire country is one giant river delta — and it is packed with people denser than anywhere else of its size.
countries.flagDescription: Bottle-green field with an off-centre red disc.
countries.outlineDescription: A river delta shaped like a funnel emptying into the Bay of Bengal.

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.hook: Bulgaria gave the world the Cyrillic alphabet — every Russian letter traces back here.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: white, green, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A blunt fist punching east toward the Black Sea.

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.hook: The five zigzag points stand for the five pillars of Islam.
countries.flagDescription: White and red divided by a zigzag of five white triangles.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny archipelago dot off the Saudi coast.

countries.name: Bahamas
countries.hook: The world's deepest blue hole, Dean's Blue Hole, drops 202 m straight down.
countries.flagDescription: Aquamarine, gold and aquamarine bands with a black hoist triangle.
countries.outlineDescription: A long chain of flat islands strung southeast of Florida.

countries.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
countries.hook: Bosnia's coast is so short you can drive past the whole thing in fifteen minutes.
countries.flagDescription: Blue field with a yellow triangle and a diagonal line of white stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough triangle with a comically short 20 km strip of coastline at Neum.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.hook: "Belarus" means White Rus — and it is the flattest, most forested country in Europe.
countries.flagDescription: Red over green with a vertical red-on-white embroidery pattern at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked blob, flat as a table, above Ukraine.

countries.name: Belize
countries.hook: The only Central American country with English as its official language.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with red edges and a white disc showing two woodcutters.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rectangle on the Caribbean side of Central America.

countries.name: Bolivia
countries.hook: Has two capitals, lost its coastline in 1884, and still maintains a navy on Lake Titicaca.
countries.flagDescription: Red, yellow and green bands with the coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked block with the Andes down its western edge.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.hook: Borders every South American country except Chile and Ecuador.
countries.flagDescription: Green field with a yellow rhombus and a blue globe reading "Ordem e Progresso".
countries.outlineDescription: A huge rounded mass filling half of South America.

countries.name: Barbados
countries.hook: The broken trident means a clean break from colonial rule — it became a republic in 2021.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, gold and blue bands with a black trident head.
countries.outlineDescription: A small pear-shaped island at the Caribbean's eastern edge.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.officialName: Nation of Brunei, Abode of Peace
countries.hook: One of the richest countries per person, thanks to oil — and its sultan's palace has 1,788 rooms.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow field with black and white diagonal stripes and a red crest.
countries.outlineDescription: Two small patches on Borneo, split in half by Malaysia.

countries.name: Bhutan
countries.hook: Measures Gross National Happiness instead of GDP, and is the only carbon-negative country on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow and orange diagonal halves with a white dragon across the middle.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rectangle perched on the Himalayan slope.

countries.name: Botswana
countries.hook: The flag's blue means rain — in the Kalahari, "pula", the currency, also means rain.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue with a black stripe bordered in white across the middle.
countries.outlineDescription: A rounded landlocked block with the Okavango delta in its north.

countries.name: Central African Republic
countries.hook: Sits almost precisely at Africa's geographic centre — hence the name.
countries.flagDescription: Four horizontal bands crossed by a vertical red stripe, with a yellow star.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked block at the exact centre of the continent.

countries.name: Canada
countries.hook: Has more lakes than the rest of the world combined, and the longest coastline on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Red and white vertical bands with a red maple leaf.
countries.outlineDescription: A vast northern mass fringed by Arctic islands.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.hook: One of only two square national flags — the other is Vatican City.
countries.flagDescription: Square red flag with a bold white cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A crumpled Alpine diamond with a tail reaching toward Geneva.

countries.name: Chile
countries.hook: Over 4,300 km long but averaging only 180 km wide — and home to the driest desert on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: White over red with a blue canton and white star.
countries.outlineDescription: An impossibly long ribbon down the Pacific coast.

countries.name: China
countries.hook: One country, one time zone — the whole 5,000 km width runs on Beijing time.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with one large and four small yellow stars in the canton.
countries.outlineDescription: A rooster facing east, tail feathers in the western deserts.

countries.name: Ivory Coast
countries.hook: Yamoussoukro holds the largest church building in the world, bigger than St Peter's.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: orange, white, green.
countries.outlineDescription: A near-square on the Gulf of Guinea coast.

countries.name: Cameroon
countries.hook: Nicknamed "Africa in miniature" because it has every African landscape in one country.
countries.flagDescription: Green, red and yellow vertical bands with a yellow star.
countries.outlineDescription: A triangle like a wedge of cheese, often called "Africa in miniature".

countries.name: DR Congo
countries.hook: The second-largest country in Africa but with only 37 km of coastline.
countries.flagDescription: Sky blue with a yellow star and a red diagonal stripe.
countries.outlineDescription: A huge blob straddling the Congo basin, with a needle-thin corridor to the sea.

countries.name: Republic of the Congo
countries.hook: Brazzaville and Kinshasa face each other across the river — the closest pair of capitals on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Green and red triangles split by a yellow diagonal band.
countries.outlineDescription: A narrow shape curling along the Congo river's western bank.

countries.name: Colombia
countries.hook: The only South American country with both Pacific and Caribbean coasts.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow, blue and red bands, the yellow half the flag's height.
countries.outlineDescription: A block at South America's corner, touching two oceans.

countries.name: Comoros
countries.hook: Has had more coup attempts than years of independence — over 20 since 1975.
countries.flagDescription: Four coloured stripes with a green triangle, crescent and four stars.
countries.outlineDescription: Three volcanic dots between Mozambique and Madagascar.

countries.name: Cape Verde
countries.hook: The ten stars are the ten islands, arranged as they actually sit in the ocean.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with white and red stripes and a ring of ten yellow stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A scatter of ten islands far out in the Atlantic.

countries.name: Costa Rica
countries.hook: Abolished its army in 1948 and spends the money on schools instead.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white, red, white, blue bands with the arms on the red.
countries.outlineDescription: A narrow S-curve between Nicaragua and Panama.

countries.name: Cuba
countries.hook: Cubans call their island "el cocodrilo" — the crocodile.
countries.flagDescription: Five blue and white stripes with a red triangle and white star.
countries.outlineDescription: A long crocodile-shaped island guarding the Gulf entrance.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.hook: The only flag showing its own map — and the copper colour is a pun: "Cyprus" gave copper its name.
countries.flagDescription: White field with a copper-coloured map of the island above two olive branches.
countries.outlineDescription: A flat pan with a long handle jutting northeast toward Syria.

countries.name: Czechia
countries.hook: The least religious country in Europe — and the highest beer consumption per person on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: White over red with a blue triangle at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A fat sideways sausage, the classic "Bohemian basin".

countries.name: Germany
countries.hook: Germany borders nine countries — more than any other European state except Russia.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: black, red, gold.
countries.outlineDescription: A broad shield widening from the Alps up to the two northern seas.

countries.name: Djibouti
countries.hook: Lake Assal is the saltiest body of water outside Antarctica and Africa's lowest point.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue over green with a white hoist triangle and red star.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny wedge at the mouth of the Red Sea.

countries.name: Dominica
countries.hook: The only flag with a purple element — the sisserou parrot's plumage.
countries.flagDescription: Green with a cross of stripes and a red disc bearing a sisserou parrot.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rugged island between the two French departments.

countries.name: Denmark
countries.hook: The Dannebrog is the oldest continuously used national flag on Earth — every Nordic cross copies it.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with an off-centre white Nordic cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A thumb of land pointing up from Germany, plus a scatter of islands.

countries.name: Dominican Republic
countries.hook: The only national flag with a Bible on it, open to the Gospel of John.
countries.flagDescription: Blue and red quarters split by a white cross with the arms centred.
countries.outlineDescription: The eastern two-thirds of the island of Hispaniola.

countries.name: Algeria
countries.hook: The largest country in Africa — and 90% of it is desert nobody lives in.
countries.flagDescription: Green and white halves with a red crescent and star.
countries.outlineDescription: A huge block, nine-tenths Sahara, with a thin habitable coastal strip.

countries.name: Ecuador
countries.hook: Named after the equator itself — and its Galápagos finches gave Darwin his theory.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow, blue and red bands with the condor coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A small block on the equator, plus the Galápagos far offshore.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.hook: Almost the entire population lives on 5% of the land, hugging the Nile.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and black bands with the golden Eagle of Saladin.
countries.outlineDescription: A square with the Nile drawn down it like a green thread.

countries.name: Eritrea
countries.hook: Fought a 30-year war for independence, the longest in modern African history.
countries.flagDescription: Red triangle on green and blue with a gold olive wreath.
countries.outlineDescription: A long thin arc along the Red Sea coast.

countries.name: Spain
countries.hook: Spain's national anthem has no words — nobody could ever agree on them.
countries.flagDescription: Red-yellow-red horizontal bands, the yellow twice as tall, with the arms at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A near-square bull's hide, with Portugal bitten out of its western side.

countries.name: Estonia
countries.hook: Estonia declared internet access a human right and lets citizens vote online.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: blue, black, white.
countries.outlineDescription: A ragged square fringed with islands on the Gulf of Finland.

countries.name: Ethiopia
countries.hook: Uses its own calendar seven years behind ours, and its own 13-month year.
countries.flagDescription: Green, yellow and red bands with a blue disc and gold star.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough triangle in the Horn's highlands, landlocked since 1993.

countries.name: Finland
countries.hook: 188,000 lakes: more lakes per person than any country in the world.
countries.flagDescription: White field with a blue Nordic cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A long maiden facing west, arm raised — Finns call it "the Finnish Maiden".

countries.name: Fiji
countries.hook: The date line bends around Fiji so the country doesn't live in two different days.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue with the Union Jack and the shield of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A cluster of islands sitting almost on the international date line.

countries.name: France
countries.hook: Because of overseas territories, France borders Brazil.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: blue, white, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A near-perfect hexagon — the French literally call their country "l'Hexagone".

countries.name: Micronesia
countries.hook: Its 607 islands spread across an ocean area larger than Western Europe.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue field with four white stars in a diamond.
countries.outlineDescription: Four island groups strung 2,700 km across the Pacific.

countries.name: Gabon
countries.hook: Over 11% of the country is national park — one of Africa's greenest nations.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: green, yellow, blue.
countries.outlineDescription: A small square on the equator, almost entirely rainforest.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.officialName: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
countries.hook: The UK has no written constitution — it simply never got around to it.
countries.flagDescription: Overlaid red and white crosses and diagonals on blue — the Union Jack.
countries.outlineDescription: A witch riding a pig, facing west, with Ireland off to the side.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.hook: Georgians have been making wine for 8,000 years — the oldest winemaking tradition known.
countries.flagDescription: White field with a large red cross and four small red crosses.
countries.outlineDescription: A small shape on the Black Sea, squeezed under the Caucasus wall.

countries.name: Ghana
countries.hook: The black star of African freedom — Ghana was the first sub-Saharan colony to go independent.
countries.flagDescription: Red, yellow and green bands with a black star in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A compact rectangle on the Gulf of Guinea, cut by Lake Volta.

countries.name: Guinea
countries.hook: The Niger, Senegal and Gambia rivers all rise in the Guinean highlands.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: red, yellow, green.
countries.outlineDescription: A crescent curving inland from the Atlantic.

countries.name: Gambia
countries.hook: The smallest mainland African country — it is essentially one river with borders.
countries.flagDescription: Red, blue and green bands separated by thin white stripes.
countries.outlineDescription: A thin sliver of land hugging both banks of one river.

countries.name: Guinea-Bissau
countries.hook: The Bijagós archipelago is a UNESCO biosphere of 88 islands, most uninhabited.
countries.flagDescription: Red hoist band with yellow over green and a black star.
countries.outlineDescription: A small coastal shape frayed into mangrove islands.

countries.name: Equatorial Guinea
countries.hook: The only African country with Spanish as an official language — and its capital is on an island.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and red bands with a blue triangle and coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A mainland square plus an island where the capital sits.

countries.name: Greece
countries.hook: Greece has roughly 6,000 islands and only about 227 are inhabited.
countries.flagDescription: Nine blue and white stripes with a white cross in the canton.
countries.outlineDescription: A hand with fingers of peninsulas dangling into the Aegean.

countries.name: Grenada
countries.hook: The only flag depicting nutmeg — it supplies a large share of the world's supply.
countries.flagDescription: Red border with yellow and green triangles and a nutmeg symbol.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny island at the southern end of the Windward chain.

countries.name: Guatemala
countries.hook: Its currency and its national bird are the same word: quetzal.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue, white and light blue vertical bands with the quetzal crest.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough square with a jagged Caribbean corner.

countries.name: Guyana
countries.hook: The only South American country with English as its official language.
countries.flagDescription: Green with a red triangle and a yellow arrowhead edged in black and white.
countries.outlineDescription: A small block on the Atlantic shoulder of South America.

countries.name: Honduras
countries.hook: The five stars are the five countries of the old Central American federation.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white and blue bands with five blue stars in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough triangle with a long Caribbean coast.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.hook: Croatia gave the world the necktie — "cravat" comes from "Hrvat", Croat.
countries.flagDescription: Red-white-blue bands with the red-and-white checkerboard shield.
countries.outlineDescription: A boomerang, or a crescent wrapping around Bosnia.

countries.name: Haiti
countries.hook: The first black republic and the only nation founded by a successful slave revolt.
countries.flagDescription: Blue over red with the coat of arms on a white panel.
countries.outlineDescription: The western third of Hispaniola, shaped like a crab's claw.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.hook: Hungarian is not related to any neighbouring language — its closest cousin is Finnish, far to the north.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: red, white, green.
countries.outlineDescription: A lopsided oval sitting in the Carpathian Basin.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.hook: So many islands that thousands have never been named.
countries.flagDescription: Two horizontal bands: red over white.
countries.outlineDescription: A string of 17,000 islands scattered along the equator like a necklace.

countries.name: India
countries.hook: The 24 spokes of the Ashoka Chakra stand for the 24 hours of the day — the flag is a clock.
countries.flagDescription: Saffron, white and green bands with a navy 24-spoke wheel.
countries.outlineDescription: A downward-pointing diamond, tip dipping into the Indian Ocean.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.hook: Green for Catholics, orange for Protestants, white for the peace between them.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: green, white, orange.
countries.outlineDescription: A teddy bear sitting down, facing west across the Atlantic.

countries.name: Iran
countries.hook: Iran, not Arabia: Persians speak Farsi, an Indo-European language cousin to English.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and red bands with the tulip emblem and Kufic script borders.
countries.outlineDescription: A cat curled up between the Caspian and the Gulf.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.hook: Mesopotamia — the land between the Tigris and Euphrates where writing was invented.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and black bands with "God is greatest" in green Kufic script.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough wedge between two rivers, narrowing to a sliver of Gulf coast.

countries.name: Iceland
countries.hook: Iceland has no mosquitoes and no army, and names babies from an approved list.
countries.flagDescription: Blue field with a red Nordic cross outlined in white.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough oval scalloped by fjords, like a chewed biscuit.

countries.name: Israel
countries.hook: The Dead Sea shore is the lowest dry land on Earth, 430 m below sea level.
countries.flagDescription: White field with two blue stripes and the blue Star of David.
countries.outlineDescription: A narrow dagger pointing south to the Red Sea.

countries.name: Italy
countries.hook: Italy has more UNESCO World Heritage sites than any other country.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: green, white, red.
countries.outlineDescription: The famous boot, kicking the football of Sicily.

countries.name: Jamaica
countries.hook: The only national flag with no red, white or blue.
countries.flagDescription: A gold saltire dividing green and black triangles.
countries.outlineDescription: A small oval island south of Cuba.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.hook: Its eastern border zigzags because a British official allegedly drew it after lunch.
countries.flagDescription: Black, white and green bands with a red hoist triangle and white star.
countries.outlineDescription: A wedge with a straight-lined "Winston's hiccup" in the eastern desert.

countries.name: Japan
countries.hook: "Land of the rising sun" — the flag is literally the sun, and the country's name says the same.
countries.flagDescription: White field with a centred crimson disc.
countries.outlineDescription: A seahorse arching down the Pacific rim.

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.hook: Bigger than all of Western Europe, yet fewer people than Nepal.
countries.flagDescription: Sky-blue field with a golden sun, eagle and hoist ornament.
countries.outlineDescription: A vast horizontal sprawl, the world's largest landlocked country.

countries.name: Kenya
countries.hook: The Great Rift Valley splits the country, and human fossils here are 3 million years old.
countries.flagDescription: Black, red and green bands with a Maasai shield and spears.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough square with Lake Victoria biting into its west.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan
countries.hook: The flag's centre is the view looking up through the roof of a nomad's yurt.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a yellow sun whose centre shows a yurt roof.
countries.outlineDescription: A small mountainous shape above China's western edge.

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.hook: The only national flag showing a building: Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Blue and red bands with a white Angkor Wat temple in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A rounded shape with the Tonlé Sap lake at its heart.

countries.name: Kiribati
countries.officialName: Independent and Sovereign Republic of Kiribati
countries.hook: The first country to see each new year — and the only one in all four hemispheres.
countries.flagDescription: Red over blue with a golden frigatebird above white and blue waves.
countries.outlineDescription: A scatter of 33 atolls straddling both the equator and the date line.

countries.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
countries.officialName: Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis
countries.hook: The smallest sovereign state in the Americas by both area and population.
countries.flagDescription: Green and red triangles split by a black diagonal with two white stars.
countries.outlineDescription: Two tiny islands in the northern Leewards.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.hook: The flag is a diagram of the universe — yin, yang, and the four elements.
countries.flagDescription: White field with a red-blue taegeuk and four black trigrams.
countries.outlineDescription: A hanging shape like a rabbit or tiger, facing Japan.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.hook: Kuwait's currency, the dinar, is the highest-valued in the world.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and red bands with a black trapezoid at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A small notch at the head of the Persian Gulf.

countries.name: Laos
countries.hook: The most heavily bombed country per person in history — and Southeast Asia's only landlocked one.
countries.flagDescription: Red, blue and red bands with a white disc in the centre.
countries.outlineDescription: A narrow landlocked strip curling along the Mekong.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.hook: The cedar of Lebanon is the only national flag featuring a specific species of tree.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and red bands with a green cedar tree.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rectangle on the eastern Mediterranean.

countries.name: Liberia
countries.hook: Founded by freed American slaves — which is why its flag looks like the Stars and Stripes.
countries.flagDescription: Eleven red and white stripes with a white star on blue.
countries.outlineDescription: A rounded shape on the West African coast.

countries.name: Libya
countries.hook: From 1977 to 2011 it had the world's only solid-colour flag: plain green.
countries.flagDescription: Red, black and green bands with a white crescent and star.
countries.outlineDescription: A large block with a Mediterranean coast curving around the Gulf of Sidra.

countries.name: Saint Lucia
countries.hook: The only country named after a woman, and it has more Nobel laureates per person than anywhere.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with a yellow and black-and-white triangular arrowhead.
countries.outlineDescription: A small teardrop island with the twin Pitons on its coast.

countries.name: Liechtenstein
countries.hook: Doubly landlocked — you must cross two borders to reach the sea.
countries.flagDescription: Blue over red with a golden crown in the upper hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A sliver on the Rhine, smaller than most cities.

countries.name: Sri Lanka
countries.officialName: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
countries.hook: Called the "teardrop of India", and the world's largest exporter of cinnamon.
countries.flagDescription: A gold lion with a sword on maroon, plus green and orange stripes.
countries.outlineDescription: A teardrop, or a pearl, hanging beneath India.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.hook: One of only three countries completely surrounded by another — and its lowest point is the world's highest.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white and green bands with a black Basotho hat.
countries.outlineDescription: A small oval hole punched entirely inside South Africa.

countries.name: Lithuania
countries.hook: Lithuania was once the largest country in Europe, stretching from the Baltic to the Black Sea.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: yellow, green, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A rounded shape like a heart lying on its side.

countries.name: Luxembourg
countries.hook: The only Grand Duchy left in the world, and the first country with free public transport nationwide.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and light blue horizontal bands.
countries.outlineDescription: A small vertical almond between Belgium, France and Germany.

countries.name: Latvia
countries.hook: More than half of Latvia is forest, and Riga's Art Nouveau quarter is the world's densest.
countries.flagDescription: Dark carmine red with a narrow white horizontal stripe.
countries.outlineDescription: A flat rectangle with a bite taken out at the Gulf of Riga.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.hook: Fez has the world's oldest continuously operating university, founded in 859.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a green interlaced pentagram.
countries.outlineDescription: A shape on Africa's northwest shoulder, facing Spain across the strait.

countries.name: Monaco
countries.hook: Monaco is smaller than New York's Central Park and has the world's densest population of millionaires.
countries.flagDescription: Two horizontal bands: red over white.
countries.outlineDescription: A speck on the French Riviera, barely two square kilometres.

countries.name: Moldova
countries.hook: Moldova has the highest density of vineyards on Earth — its wine cellars run for 200 km underground.
countries.flagDescription: Blue-yellow-red vertical bands with an eagle-and-aurochs crest.
countries.outlineDescription: A long bunch of grapes hanging between Romania and Ukraine.

countries.name: Madagascar
countries.hook: About 90% of its wildlife exists nowhere else on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: White hoist band with red over green.
countries.outlineDescription: A long island off Mozambique, shaped like a left footprint.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.hook: The flattest and lowest country on Earth — its highest natural point is under 2.5 m.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a green rectangle and a white crescent.
countries.outlineDescription: A chain of atoll dots strung southwest of India.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.hook: The flag shows the Aztec founding legend of Tenochtitlán, now Mexico City.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and red bands with an eagle eating a snake on a cactus.
countries.outlineDescription: A curving horn with the Yucatán hook and the long Baja finger.

countries.name: Marshall Islands
countries.hook: Bikini Atoll's nuclear tests gave the swimsuit its name.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with orange and white diagonal stripes and a 24-pointed star.
countries.outlineDescription: Two chains of low coral atolls in the central Pacific.

countries.name: North Macedonia
countries.hook: Had to add "North" to its name in 2019 to settle a 27-year argument with Greece.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a golden sun radiating eight broadening rays.
countries.outlineDescription: A small landlocked blob just north of Greece.

countries.name: Mali
countries.hook: Timbuktu was a centre of learning with libraries when much of Europe was illiterate.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: green, yellow, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A butterfly shape, its northern wing lost in the Sahara.

countries.name: Malta
countries.hook: The most densely populated country in the EU, and among the sunniest.
countries.flagDescription: White and red vertical halves with the George Cross in the upper hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: Two tiny specks of limestone south of Sicily.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.officialName: Republic of the Union of Myanmar
countries.hook: Moved its capital overnight in 2005 to a brand-new, near-empty city, Naypyidaw.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow, green and red bands with a large white star.
countries.outlineDescription: A kite with a long ribbon tail running down the Andaman coast.

countries.name: Montenegro
countries.hook: Its name means "black mountain" in Venetian — the locals call it Crna Gora, which means the same.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with gold border and the double-headed eagle crest.
countries.outlineDescription: A small triangle of black mountains on the Adriatic.

countries.name: Mongolia
countries.hook: The least densely populated sovereign country on Earth — more horses than people.
countries.flagDescription: Red-blue-red vertical bands with the golden Soyombo symbol at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A long horizontal shape squeezed between Russia and China.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.hook: The only national flag with a modern assault rifle on it.
countries.flagDescription: Green, black and yellow bands with a red triangle, rifle, hoe and book.
countries.outlineDescription: A long coastal ribbon curving down the Indian Ocean.

countries.name: Mauritania
countries.hook: The last country on Earth to abolish slavery, in 1981.
countries.flagDescription: Green field with a gold crescent and star between two red stripes.
countries.outlineDescription: A large desert block on the Atlantic's northwest bulge.

countries.name: Mauritius
countries.hook: The dodo lived here and nowhere else — and the only country in Africa with a Hindu majority.
countries.flagDescription: Four horizontal bands: red, blue, yellow, green.
countries.outlineDescription: A single small island east of Madagascar.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.hook: Lake Malawi holds more fish species than any other lake in the world.
countries.flagDescription: Black, red and green bands with a rising red sun.
countries.outlineDescription: A long thin strip wrapped around the western side of a great lake.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.hook: One country in two pieces, separated by 640 km of South China Sea.
countries.flagDescription: Fourteen red and white stripes with a blue canton, crescent and star.
countries.outlineDescription: Split in two: a peninsula, plus a chunk of northern Borneo.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.hook: The Caprivi Strip was drawn so Germany could reach the Zambezi — a colonial afterthought.
countries.flagDescription: Blue and green split by a red diagonal, with a golden sun.
countries.outlineDescription: A block on the Atlantic with a thin Caprivi finger reaching east.

countries.name: Niger
countries.hook: Consistently among the world's youngest populations — half its people are under 15.
countries.flagDescription: Orange, white and green bands with an orange disc.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked shape widening north into the Sahara.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.hook: Africa's most populous country, split almost evenly between Muslim north and Christian south.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: green, white, green.
countries.outlineDescription: A broad block with the Niger delta fanning into the Gulf.

countries.name: Nicaragua
countries.hook: Lake Nicaragua holds the world's only freshwater sharks.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white and blue bands with a triangle, volcanoes and rainbow.
countries.outlineDescription: A triangle with two huge lakes in its southwest.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.hook: A third of the country sits below sea level — the Dutch literally built their own land.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: red, white, blue.
countries.outlineDescription: A crouching lion, with a fringe of reclaimed polder along the sea.

countries.name: Norway
countries.hook: Norway's fjord-cut coastline is over 25,000 km — long enough to circle half the planet.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a blue Nordic cross outlined in white.
countries.outlineDescription: A long spine, like a tiger stretching down the Scandinavian coast.

countries.name: Nepal
countries.hook: The only country without a rectangular flag — and home to eight of the world's ten highest peaks.
countries.flagDescription: The only non-rectangular flag: two stacked crimson pennants with moon and sun.
countries.outlineDescription: A rectangle tilted along the Himalaya, wide but shallow.

countries.name: Nauru
countries.hook: The world's smallest republic — 21 km², with no official capital city.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with a yellow horizontal stripe and a white twelve-pointed star.
countries.outlineDescription: A single tiny oval island just south of the equator.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.hook: Home to more sheep than people, and the first country to give women the vote.
countries.flagDescription: Blue with the Union Jack and four red stars of the Southern Cross.
countries.outlineDescription: Two long islands, one narrow and one broad, southeast of Australia.

countries.name: Oman
countries.hook: Oman guards the Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of the world's oil sails.
countries.flagDescription: White, red and green with a red hoist band bearing crossed swords and a dagger.
countries.outlineDescription: An angled shape on the Arabian corner, plus an exclave at Musandam.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.hook: The white stripe is deliberately for religious minorities — a promise stitched into the flag.
countries.flagDescription: Dark green with a white crescent and star, and a white hoist stripe.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough diamond with the Indus running down its spine.

countries.name: Panama
countries.hook: Because it curves, the sun rises over the Pacific and sets over the Atlantic here.
countries.flagDescription: Four quarters: white with blue star, red, white with red star, blue.
countries.outlineDescription: An S-shaped isthmus, running east-west rather than north-south.

countries.name: Peru
countries.hook: Machu Picchu was never found by the Spanish — it stayed hidden until 1911.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and red vertical bands with the coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A block on the Pacific with the Andes and Amazon behind it.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.hook: The only flag that flips: red goes on top when the country is at war.
countries.flagDescription: Blue over red with a white hoist triangle, sun and three stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A scatter of 7,600 islands shaped like a ragged Y.

countries.name: Palau
countries.hook: The yellow disc is the moon, not the sun — and Palau created the world's first shark sanctuary.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue field with an off-centre yellow disc.
countries.outlineDescription: A small archipelago at the western edge of Micronesia.

countries.name: Papua New Guinea
countries.officialName: Independent State of Papua New Guinea
countries.hook: Over 840 languages are spoken here — more than in any other country on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Diagonal split: black with the Southern Cross, red with a bird-of-paradise.
countries.outlineDescription: The eastern half of New Guinea plus a fan of islands.

countries.name: Poland
countries.hook: Poland has moved on the map so often that the same family could be born in three countries without leaving home.
countries.flagDescription: Two horizontal bands: white over red.
countries.outlineDescription: A rounded square between Germany and the vastness of the east.

countries.name: North Korea
countries.hook: Uses its own calendar counting from 1912, the birth year of Kim Il-sung.
countries.flagDescription: Blue-red-blue bands with a white disc and red star.
countries.outlineDescription: The northern half of the Korean peninsula, bordering three countries.

countries.name: Portugal
countries.hook: The oldest fixed borders in Europe — essentially unchanged since 1297.
countries.flagDescription: Green and red vertical bands with an armillary sphere and shield.
countries.outlineDescription: A tall narrow rectangle facing the Atlantic.

countries.name: Paraguay
countries.hook: The only national flag with a different design on its front and back.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and blue bands — with different emblems on each side.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked shape split by the Paraguay river.

countries.name: Palestine
countries.hook: Recognised by most of the world's countries but not by all — a state in fragments.
countries.flagDescription: Black, white and green bands with a red triangle at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: Two separated pieces: the West Bank and the Gaza Strip.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.hook: The world's only flag that is longer than twice its height.
countries.flagDescription: Maroon field with a white serrated band of nine points at the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A thumb sticking straight up into the Persian Gulf.

countries.name: Romania
countries.hook: The only Romance-speaking country in a sea of Slavic neighbours — a linguistic island.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: blue, yellow, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A fish curling around the Carpathian arc, tail in the Danube delta.

countries.name: Russia
countries.hook: Russia is so wide that when Moscow eats breakfast, Vladivostok is going to bed.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: white, blue, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A vast horizontal sprawl covering eleven time zones.

countries.name: Rwanda
countries.hook: Called "land of a thousand hills", and one of the few countries with more women than men in parliament.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, yellow and green bands with a golden sun.
countries.outlineDescription: A tiny landlocked shape of a thousand hills.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.hook: The flag is never flown at half-mast — it bears the name of God.
countries.flagDescription: Green field with the Shahada in white script above a sword.
countries.outlineDescription: A large shield filling most of the Arabian Peninsula.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.hook: Sudan has more pyramids than Egypt — around 200 of them at Meroë.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and black bands with a green hoist triangle.
countries.outlineDescription: A large block on the Red Sea, split by the Nile's confluence.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.hook: Senegal completely surrounds The Gambia except for its coastline.
countries.flagDescription: Green, yellow and red bands with a green star.
countries.outlineDescription: A shape wrapping almost entirely around The Gambia.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.hook: A city-state that has grown 25% larger by reclaiming land from the sea.
countries.flagDescription: Red over white with a white crescent and five stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A single small diamond island at the tip of Malaysia.

countries.name: Solomon Islands
countries.hook: The site of Guadalcanal, one of the Pacific War's decisive battles.
countries.flagDescription: Blue and green triangles split by a yellow diagonal, with five white stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A double chain of islands running southeast from New Guinea.

countries.name: Sierra Leone
countries.hook: Named "lion mountains" by a Portuguese sailor who heard thunder in the hills.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: green, white, blue.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rounded shape with a mountainous peninsula at Freetown.

countries.name: El Salvador
countries.hook: The smallest country in Central America, and the only one facing only the Pacific.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white and blue bands with the coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rectangle, the only Central American country with no Caribbean coast.

countries.name: San Marino
countries.officialName: Most Serene Republic of San Marino
countries.hook: The world's oldest surviving republic — founded in the year 301.
countries.flagDescription: White over light blue with the three-towered coat of arms.
countries.outlineDescription: A pinprick on an Italian mountaintop.

countries.name: Somalia
countries.hook: Has Africa's longest mainland coastline, over 3,000 km.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue field with a white five-pointed star.
countries.outlineDescription: The Horn itself — a long hook curving around Ethiopia.

countries.name: Serbia
countries.hook: Serbia lost its coastline when Montenegro left in 2006 — and Belgrade sits where the Sava meets the Danube.
countries.flagDescription: Red-blue-white bands with the double-headed eagle shield.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked wedge at the heart of the Balkans.

countries.name: South Sudan
countries.hook: The world's youngest country, independent in 2011.
countries.flagDescription: Black, red and green bands with a blue triangle and gold star.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked blob with the vast Sudd wetland at its centre.

countries.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
countries.officialName: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
countries.hook: The second-smallest African country, and the equator runs through its islet of Rolas.
countries.flagDescription: Green, yellow and green bands with a red triangle and two black stars.
countries.outlineDescription: Two tiny volcanic islands sitting on the equator.

countries.name: Suriname
countries.hook: The most forested country on Earth — over 90% is still jungle.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white, red, white, green bands with a yellow star.
countries.outlineDescription: A small block between Guyana and French Guiana.

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.hook: Bratislava is the only capital that borders two other countries — Austria and Hungary.
countries.flagDescription: White-blue-red bands with a shield bearing a double cross on three hills.
countries.outlineDescription: A long thin shape like a chilli pepper lying east-west.

countries.name: Slovenia
countries.hook: Over half the country is forest, and the only country with "love" hidden in its name.
countries.flagDescription: White-blue-red bands with a shield showing Mount Triglav.
countries.outlineDescription: A hen facing west, with a tiny beak of coastline.

countries.name: Sweden
countries.hook: Sweden imports rubbish from other countries because its recycling plants run out of fuel.
countries.flagDescription: Blue field with a yellow Nordic cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A long tapered wedge, wide at the top, pointing south.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.hook: One of the world's last absolute monarchies, renamed from Swaziland in 2018.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, yellow, red bands with a Nguni shield and spears.
countries.outlineDescription: A small landlocked square tucked into South Africa's east.

countries.name: Seychelles
countries.hook: The smallest African country by population — fewer people than a mid-sized town.
countries.flagDescription: Five rays of blue, yellow, red, white and green fanning from the hoist.
countries.outlineDescription: A scatter of 115 granite and coral islands in the Indian Ocean.

countries.name: Syria
countries.hook: Damascus is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Green, white and black bands with three red stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough rectangle with a pointed eastern tail along the Euphrates.

countries.name: Chad
countries.hook: Lake Chad has shrunk by over 90% since the 1960s.
countries.flagDescription: Three vertical bands: blue, yellow, red.
countries.outlineDescription: A tall landlocked shape stretching from the Sahara to the savanna.

countries.name: Togo
countries.hook: Only about 50 km wide at the coast but 550 km tall.
countries.flagDescription: Five green and yellow stripes with a red canton and white star.
countries.outlineDescription: A very narrow vertical strip, one of Africa's thinnest.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.hook: The only Southeast Asian country never colonised by a European power.
countries.flagDescription: Red, white, blue, white, red horizontal bands, the blue twice as tall.
countries.outlineDescription: An elephant's head with the trunk stretching down the Malay peninsula.

countries.name: Tajikistan
countries.hook: Over 90% mountains — the Pamirs here are called "the roof of the world".
countries.flagDescription: Red, white and green bands with a golden crown and seven stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A jagged mountainous shape with a westward-reaching valley.

countries.name: Turkmenistan
countries.hook: The Karakum desert holds the "Door to Hell", a gas crater burning since 1971.
countries.flagDescription: Green field with a vertical carpet-pattern stripe and crescent with stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A blocky shape on the Caspian, mostly desert.

countries.name: Timor-Leste
countries.hook: One of the youngest countries on Earth, independent only since 2002.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with black and yellow triangles and a white star.
countries.outlineDescription: The eastern half of an island, plus a small exclave.

countries.name: Tonga
countries.hook: The only Pacific island nation never colonised, and still ruled by its own king.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a white canton bearing a red cross.
countries.outlineDescription: A north-south chain of islands east of Fiji.

countries.name: Trinidad and Tobago
countries.hook: The birthplace of the steelpan, the only acoustic instrument invented in the 20th century.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a black diagonal edged in white.
countries.outlineDescription: Two islands just off the Venezuelan coast.

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.hook: The Arab Spring started here in 2010 — and Star Wars' Tatooine was filmed in its desert.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a white disc containing a red crescent and star.
countries.outlineDescription: A small shape at Africa's northern tip, closest point to Europe.

countries.name: Türkiye
countries.hook: The only country sitting squarely on two continents, with Istanbul split between them.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a white crescent and star.
countries.outlineDescription: A rectangle bridging two continents, wide from west to east.

countries.name: Tuvalu
countries.hook: Earns much of its income from renting out its internet domain: .tv.
countries.flagDescription: Light blue with the Union Jack and nine yellow stars in island positions.
countries.outlineDescription: Nine tiny atolls barely rising from the western Pacific.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.hook: Taiwanese affectionately call their island "the sweet potato" for its shape.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a blue canton bearing a white twelve-rayed sun.
countries.outlineDescription: A sweet-potato-shaped island off China's coast.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.hook: Home to Africa's highest point, Kilimanjaro, and its deepest lake, Tanganyika.
countries.flagDescription: Green and blue split by a black diagonal edged in yellow.
countries.outlineDescription: A rough square with Kilimanjaro on its northern edge.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.hook: The source of the White Nile is here, at Jinja on Lake Victoria.
countries.flagDescription: Six black, yellow and red stripes with a grey crowned crane.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked block touching Lake Victoria's north shore.

countries.name: Ukraine
countries.hook: Blue sky over yellow wheat — the flag is a picture of the steppe that fed Europe.
countries.flagDescription: Two horizontal bands: blue over yellow.
countries.outlineDescription: A broad shape with the Crimean diamond hanging into the Black Sea.

countries.name: Uruguay
countries.hook: The first country to legalise cannabis nationwide, and it runs almost entirely on renewables.
countries.flagDescription: Nine white and blue stripes with the Sun of May in the canton.
countries.outlineDescription: A small rounded shape between Brazil and Argentina.

countries.name: United States
countries.hook: The current 50-star flag was designed by a 17-year-old for a school project — he got a B minus.
countries.flagDescription: Thirteen red and white stripes with fifty white stars on blue.
countries.outlineDescription: A wide block with Alaska and Hawaii detached to the northwest.

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.hook: Doubly landlocked — one of only two such countries, with Liechtenstein.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, white and green bands with a crescent and twelve stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked shape sprawling west from the Fergana Valley.

countries.name: Vatican City
countries.hook: The smallest country on Earth, with more popes than square kilometres.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow and white vertical halves with the crossed keys and tiara.
countries.outlineDescription: A walled speck inside Rome, 0.49 km².

countries.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
countries.hook: The three diamonds form a V for Vincent — and the Grenadines are 32 islands and cays.
countries.flagDescription: Blue, gold and green bands with three green diamonds in a V.
countries.outlineDescription: A main island with a chain of small Grenadines trailing south.

countries.name: Venezuela
countries.hook: Angel Falls here is the world's tallest waterfall, so high the water vaporises before landing.
countries.flagDescription: Yellow, blue and red bands with an arc of eight white stars.
countries.outlineDescription: A block on the Caribbean with the Orinoco delta to the east.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.hook: At its narrowest the country is under 50 km wide — you can cross it in an hour.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a large yellow five-pointed star.
countries.outlineDescription: A long S-shaped dragon hugging the coast, narrow in the middle.

countries.name: Vanuatu
countries.hook: Regularly ranked the most natural-disaster-prone country in the world.
countries.flagDescription: Red and green split by a black Y with a yellow outline and a boar's tusk.
countries.outlineDescription: A Y-shaped chain of volcanic islands.

countries.name: Samoa
countries.hook: Skipped 30 December 2011 entirely to jump across the date line and trade with Australia.
countries.flagDescription: Red field with a blue canton bearing the Southern Cross.
countries.outlineDescription: Two main volcanic islands in the central South Pacific.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.hook: Socotra island is so isolated that a third of its plants grow nowhere else on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Three horizontal bands: red, white, black.
countries.outlineDescription: A wedge at Arabia's southwest corner, guarding the Red Sea gate.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.hook: The only country with three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein.
countries.flagDescription: Six colours in a horizontal Y-shape — green, gold, white, red, blue, black.
countries.outlineDescription: A block with Lesotho as a hole and Eswatini notched into its east.

countries.name: Zambia
countries.hook: Shares Victoria Falls with Zimbabwe — the largest sheet of falling water on Earth.
countries.flagDescription: Green field with red, black and orange stripes and an eagle at the fly.
countries.outlineDescription: A butterfly or figure-eight shape, landlocked in the south.

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.hook: Once printed a 100 trillion dollar note during hyperinflation.
countries.flagDescription: Seven coloured stripes with a white triangle and the Zimbabwe Bird.
countries.outlineDescription: A landlocked shape like a teapot, bordered by the Zambezi and Limpopo.
